communication.admm_full: b rounds per sample (one per iteration), interface floats both ways per iteration (DistributedMPC.floats)
communication.admm_quot: b + 2 rounds per sample: gather inside every row (6 n floats), b rounds between the rows' agents (quotient interface floats), broadcast inside every row (3 n floats)
communication.coordinated: 2 rounds per sample: states up (6 n floats), inputs down (3 n floats)
communication.team_central: 2 rounds per sample: states up (6 n floats), team inputs down (3 n floats); averaging and lift at the central computer
